task_description: Build the NestJS modular-monolith backend at apps/api for the Lifelong Human Development platform: content (read-only phase serving), auth (JWT + roles), users (caregiver<->learner links), progress (ownership-scoped), and ai (RAG over vetted curriculum with a support-never-replace guardrail). Persistence via a repository abstraction with an in-memory default and a Prisma/Postgres impl selected by DATABASE_URL, so build and tests never need a live DB. Only create/modify files under apps/api plus additive root package.json scripts.
